title: The Last Order
hook: Every night delivery driver in town knows one rule: if the app sends you to 14 Larkin Road after midnight, cancel it.
lines: I deliver food at night, and the other drivers warned me about one address.
Fourteen Larkin Road. If the app ever sends you there after midnight... cancel it.
And if you can't cancel... leave the bag on the step, and never look in the window.
For weeks, it never came up. Just burgers, and empty streets.
Then, at two-forty one morning, my phone chimed. Fourteen Larkin Road.
I tapped cancel. Nothing happened. The button had gone gray.
The house sat alone at the end of a dirt road. Every window dark.
I set the bag on the step... and I looked.
The living room was full of people. Standing perfectly still. All of them... facing the door.
I walked back to my car... and drove home with the radio off.
At three a.m., my phone chimed again.
Not an order for me to deliver. An order on its way... to me.
Driver... Fourteen Larkin Road. Arriving now.
Then my doorbell rang. And a note lit up my screen. Please don't look in the window.
